description: Lists the action items in the connected account, newest first. Each has its id, title, description, rationale, status, priority, pillar, phase, estimated cost range, suggested tools, remediation guidance, the source it came from (source_type and source_id: a Diagnostic, which get_report reads, or a Citation, Crawlability or Accessibility Scan, which get_citation_scan, get_crawlability_scan or get_accessibility_scan reads), client_id, assignee and due date. Statuses: suggested, queued, in_progress, completed (the person doing it says it is done), confirmed (a second person signed off), verified (a later Diagnostic saw the fix from outside) and dismissed. Filters: client_id, source_id and status. An empty page means none were returned for these filters. Fits "what should we fix first" and progress reviews. Changes to an action item are made in the Yellowhead app, or through a connection an account admin set up there.
